title: Mere Lab Par Jo Zainab Ka Naam Aagaya
body:
1. NAAM SUNTE HI ZAINAB KA DIL NE KAHA
SAR JHUKAO ADAB KA MUQAAM AAGAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
2. MERE SAJDE JAHAN KAAM AA NA SAKE
EK AANSU WAHA MERE KAAM AAGAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. DEKH KAR MUJHKO MEHSHAR ME BOLE MALAK
RAASTA DO ALI KA GHULAAM AAGAYA
4.JITNA ITRAAO QISMAT PE KAM HAI HABEEB
BINTE ZEHRA KA TUJH KO SALAM AAGAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
5. NAZHA KI MUSHKILE SAARI ASAAN HUWI
MERI BAALI PE MERA IMAM AAGAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
6. AYE NAZAR MADHAKHANO Kl FEHRIST ME
SATH MEESUM KE MERA BHI NAAM AAGAYA
